subject.title: fix: allow trusted host-read html after outbound staging

question: Should OpenClaw accept outbound-staged generated HTML as trusted host-read HTML when the staged realpath has matching SQLite sha256/size provenance?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and fail-closed, but accepting a new trusted local HTML lifecycle is a security boundary decision that automation should not make.

options.title: Accept provenance-gated trust
options.body: Merge after a security owner confirms the sha256/size SQLite marker lifecycle is the intended boundary for staged generated HTML.

options.title: Request tighter lifecycle changes
options.body: Ask the contributor to add bounded row TTL/chunked prune behavior or other hardening before accepting the boundary.

options.title: Reject this boundary
options.body: Keep the linked bug open and require a different design that avoids trusting outbound-staged HTML after reload.

recommendation.title: Accept provenance-gated trust
recommendation.body: Merge after a security owner confirms the sha256/size SQLite marker lifecycle is the intended boundary for staged generated HTML.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the original trusted-generated-HTML host-read seam that this PR extends.
